eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Maricopa, AZ; at 9:53 PM on AUG 18, 2026 Effective until 5:53 AM AUG 19, 2026. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety. A safe Alert has been issued for Maricopa County. The Surprise Police Department is looking for 18-year-old Mariana Magana Morfin. Mariana left her residence in the area of Christy Drive and Greer Ranch Parkway on 08/17/2026 with no known property except her English Terrier Puppy. Left her wallet and other items behind. Mariana is a Hispanic female, 125 pounds, brown hair, and brown eyes.  She is wearing a white shirt, blue jeans and white shoes. She suffers from a medical condition that may cause her to become lost and easily confused.  Please call 911 with any information. If you have contact with this SAFE Alert, please call 911. Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
